newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were mostly steady on Friday despite sharply lower CBOT corn and soymeal prices, dealers said.
But several dealers said they expected millfeed values to decline in the near term in tandem with weaker corn and meal.
"Sellers are trying to hang on to their prices," one southern dealer said. "But I feel prices will be slipping."
Most dealers said business was fairly quiet with many buyers standing on the sidelines.
"There is a little interest for nearby feed but with the (CBOT) board down on meal and corn, people are not buyers today," a Buffalo dealer said.

CBOT soy product futures tumbled amid a bearishly construed USDA crop production report. USDA early Friday said 1996 U.S. soybean production would total 2.346 billion bushels, above an average trade estimate for 2.287 billion and up from USDA's September forecast for 2.270 billion.
